Last month a creator turned down our offer, and it was the most useful no of the year.

She showed us exactly where our brief was vague, and the next five creators said yes.

What is the best feedback you ever got from a no?

Three things I check before any paid collaboration:
- the last ten videos, not the best ten
- who comments, not how many
- whether the audience asks real questions

What would you add to the list?
